title: PhiBE-Q-Learning: Bridging Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning and Continuous-Time Control
summary: In this paper, we develop an off-policy method for continuous-time reinforcement learning (CTRL), where the system dynamics are governed by an unknown stochastic differential equation (SDE) and only discrete-time trajectory data are available. A central challenge is that the classical discrete-time state--action value function loses its action-dependent signal in the continuous-time limit (Baird, 1994; Jia and Zhou, 2023; Tallec et al., 2019).
